scenes.line1: How do you handle tricky changes?
scenes.say: How do you handle tricky changes in Git? Which tool fits the job?

scenes.label: Cherry-pick
scenes.sub: Apply a specific commit to your branch.
scenes.say: Cherry-pick lets you apply a specific commit to your current branch. Use it for selective integration.
Stash temporarily saves changes not ready to commit. Switch tasks, then restore your work with stash pop.

scenes.title: Find a bug with bisect
scenes.say: Bisect helps find the commit that introduced a bug. Start, mark bad and good commits, and let Git narrow it down.

scenes.question: Is stash for permanent backups?
scenes.right: No, stash is temporary. Use commits for permanent backups.
